pages.title: A Patient Teacher
pages.text: Compare the same attack against different protection before a real expedition.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Compare the same weapon’s readouts. Click the body part to remove its armor; sneak and hit empty-handed to remove the dummy. Undead heads, turtle helmets and an illager banner change its simulated target type. A pumpkin makes a scarecrow, and a dispenser can place it.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A dummy compares armor and weapons; heads alter target type, pumpkin enables scarecrow behavior, and a dispenser places it. These are distinct settings of one practical tool.
